subject: general
question: In 2020, Vijaynagara became the 31st district of which of the following states?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Karnataka**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Vijaynagara became the** 31st district of ****Karnataka**.
 
• It was carved out from the **Ballari district**.
 
• There are six taluks that come under Vijayanagara which are **Hosapete, Kudligi, Hagaribommanahalli, Kotturu, Hoovina Hadagali, and Harapanahalli**.
 
• There are** two UNESCO World Heritage** sites **Hampi and Virupaksha Temple** in Vijaynagara.
 
• The creation of districts will help** ****promote tourism to places such as Hampi and the overall development of the six taluks**.
